prediction_outcome: Target annual report has reported SSI count greater than source predicted SSI count (O>E). This is an annual report alert, not infection onset.
training: California target years 2017-2022, Adult and Pediatric.
test: California target years 2023-2025, Adult and Pediatric.
external: Oregon target year 2017 with Oregon 2016 features; no hospital identity join to California. Geographic transport check using historical outcomes, not a later-time validation; California training ends in 2022.
feature_history: Available reports in t-3 to t-1. Requires immediate previous year t-1. Missing older years contribute no unobserved values; aggregate only available history.
zero_expected: Retained when nonnegative and finite; alert defined by count comparison and model predictors use half-count smoothing.
unit_definition: Canonical State|county|hospital name, age group and procedure. Consecutive annual reports paired within this identity.
rounding: Predicted and comparator scores rounded to 12 significant digits for exact ties.
